Class MRuntime

java.lang.Object
mjvm.runtime.MRuntime
public final class MRuntime extends Object
mJVM runtime (M2/M3) — executes Ir against a StoreApi. Compiled classes call back into this runtime for I/O and variables so the JvMumps store SPI stays the single persistence contract.
